locator: FLA baseline assessment, executive summary and section 5 « Forced Labor », including the case study on wage retention
summary: The FLA describes one worker case involving retention of wages, changes to oral working agreements, lack of written contract and no grievance mechanism. It states that these indicators point toward a risk of forced labour in the cocoa-farming supply chain assessed.
limitations: The report identifies risk indicators in a case involving a worker in the supplier chain; it does not state that Nestlé directly employed the worker or that the case represents the whole supply chain.
